question: Two short bar magnets with magnetic moments $M_1$ and $M_2$ ($M_1 > M_2$) are placed one over the other on a vibration magnetometer. When their like poles are touching (North on North), the system oscillates with a frequency of $15\, \text{Hz}$. When one magnet is reversed so that unlike poles are touching (North on South), the frequency drops to $5\, \text{Hz}$. The ratio of their magnetic moments $M_1 : M_2$ is:
